proof: Children visibly laughing and engaged while playing; no before/after or results shown

convincing: Interpretation: the children's natural reactions and the quick skit make the game look fun rather than pushed; the timer mechanic is easy to grasp.
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: scripted performance feels a little staged; no price, no purchase route, no parent testimony, low reach (661 plays).
